results.title: Preview Côte d'Ivoire vs Scotland: World Cup warm-up friendly - VAVEL International
highlights:
Scotland and Côte d’Ivoire will continue their World Cup preparations as they travel to Everton’s Hill Dickinson Stadium for their first-ever encounter.
[...]
After their euphoric victory over Denmark booked their place in North America, Scotland got their pre-tournament preparations off to a limp start with a lacklustre 1-0 defeat to Japan. However, these friendlies offer manager Steve Clarke the opportunity to tune his squad and make the most of their first appearance at the finals since 1998.
[...]
Meanwhile, Côte d’Ivoire come into this game in fine form having beaten a rotated South Korea side 4-0 in Milton Keynes, and Emerse Faé will be looking to test his squad yet again before they return to the World Cup for the first time in 12 years.
[...]
This match has plenty of intrigue, and fans will have their eyes peeled to see how the squads hold up with the tournament looming large for both teams.
[...]
After thumping South Korea last time out,
[...]
will be hoping to test
[...]
Scotland manager Clarke has made it clear that he wanted to face African opposition before they play Morocco in the second game of their World Cup campaign, meaning that he will likely put out his strongest possible lineup to test his team against the 2023 AFCON champions.
[...]
This means there will likely be little alterations to the
[...]
The main question mark is up front, as Lyndon Dykes was brought off for George Hirst after about an hour in that match, meaning we may see the Ipswich Town forward tasked with leading the line. Alternatively, Tommy Conway will hope to get the chance to stake his claim for the starting shirt after being deployed out wide, while Che Adams is an experienced option for Clark to ponder.
[...]
Scott McTominay has been an integral part of Scotland’s successes in recent years, and once again he seems destined to be the man that Steve Clarke’s team turn to if they are to get a momentum boosting result in this friendly.
[...]
Since his move to Napoli from Manchester United in 2024, he has taken up a talismanic role both for his club and for his national team. This includes critical contributions as he helped Napoli to the 2025 Scudetto, before his bicycle kick got proceedings off to the perfect start on the night Scotland secured their place in the 2026 World Cup.
[...]
If Scotland are to advance beyond the group stage of the World Cup for the first time ever, then McTominay will once again have to deliver on the biggest stage. This game is the perfect opportunity for the former Manchester United midfielder to show his quality in the Tartan jersey before the tournament kicks off.
[...]
This fixture will be held at Hill Dickinson Stadium, the home of Everton FC.
[...]
Kick-off is at 19:30 GMT

results.title: Scotland vs Ivory Coast Prediction and Betting Tips | March 31st 2026
highlights:
Scotland vs Ivory Coast Prediction and Betting Tips
[...]
202
[...]
Scotland and Ivory Coast continue their preparations for the upcoming FIFA World Cup when they lock horns in an international friendly at Hill Dickinson Stadium on Tuesday. Both sides picked up contrasting results at the weekend, with Les Elephants claiming a dominant victory over South Korea.
[...]
Scotland kicked off their friendly preparations for the World Cup on a sour note last weekend when they fell to a 1-0 defeat at the hands of Japan.
[...]
This followed a solid run in the World Cup qualifiers, where they picked up four wins and one draw from their six games in Group C to clinch top spot and an automatic ticket to the global tournament.
[...]
Scotland will follow Tuesday’s tie with their final warm-up game against Curacao on May 30, before taking on Haiti in the Group C opener of the World Cup on June 14.
[...]
On the other hand, Ivory Coast turned in a solid team display last Saturday, when they cruised to a 4-0 victory over South Korea at Stadium MK.
[...]
This followed a somewhat disappointing run in the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations, where Les Elephants crashed out in the quarter-finals courtesy of a narrow 3-2 loss against record champions Egypt.
[...]
Ivory Coast have been drawn in Group E of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, alongside Ecuador, four-time champions Germany, and debutants Curacao.
[...]
## Scotland vs Ivory Coast Head-To-Head and Key Numbers
[...]
- This will be the very first meeting between Scotland and the Ivory Coast, and both nations will look to begin their rivalry on a positive note.
- Ivory Coast are unbeaten in eight of their most recent nine friendly outings, picking up six victories and one draw since March 2024.
- Scotland have won just two of their last nine friendly matches since September 2023, while losing six and claiming one draw in that time.
- Ivory Coast are unbeaten in six of their most recent eight away games across all competitions, picking up five wins and one draw since June 2025.
[...]
## Scotland vs Ivory Coast Prediction
[...]
Scotland and the Ivory Coast are expected to name a shuffled XI on Tuesday, but we expect both sides to be up for the challenge at the Hill Dickinson Stadium.
[...]
Ivory Coast are unbeaten in six of their last seven matches in all competitions, and we are backing them to come out on top in a thrilling contest.
[...]
Prediction: Scotland 1-2 Ivory Coast
[...]
## Scotland vs Ivory Coast Betting Tips
[...]
Tip 1: Result - Ivory Coast to win
[...]
Tip 2: Over 2.5 goals - Yes (There have been three or more goals scored in four of Scotland’s last five outings)
[...]
Tip 3: Both sides to score - Yes (Both sides have also scored in four of Scotland's last five games)
